acceptance: FingerprintIntegrity defines TRUNCATED or explicitly documents UNVERIFIED handling for depth-truncated trees
QueryPlanDAG.from_dict does not label a depth-truncated plan as STALE when plan.truncated_at_depth is not None
is_fingerprint_trusted() returns False for truncated plans without falsely labeling them as corrupted/tampered
Unit tests in test_query_plan_models.py verify truncation round-trip and integrity state
context: Adversarial audit finding QPC-DEF-06. Plans serialized with intentional depth truncation (truncated_at_depth) falsely reload as FingerprintIntegrity.STALE in from_dict(verify_fingerprint=True) because the recomputed truncated tree does not match the stored full-tree fingerprint. STALE indicates tampering/corruption, producing false-positive tamper warnings.
description: Fix QueryPlanDAG.from_dict() integrity verification so plans serialized with intentional max_depth truncation do not falsely land in FingerprintIntegrity.STALE. Introduce an explicit FingerprintIntegrity.TRUNCATED state (or set UNVERIFIED), ensuring untrusted status without false tamper attribution.
